we have successfully used synthetic data to train a deep net for a real world problem and shown that the network can be made to work on the real data.

The main takeaway from our work is that
deep nets trained on synthetic data alone can perform pretty well, but finetuning on the real data helps in achieving state of the art results.
a simple architecture with dilated convolutional layers is sufficient to perform accurate wire detection, with the help of a synthetic data set and a grid search over architectures.
synthetic data can be used for pretraining and finetuning deep networks for wire detection.
